reviewGaps.reason: Detailed wallet-randomness failure observations are concentrated in Episode 66. They were not merged with application sign-in keys merely because both involve cryptography.
The detailed fundraising/dilution mechanism is concentrated in Episode 68. Broader business ownership arguments remain distinct.
Detailed novelty/proof questions in Episode 60 remain distinct from the broader verification comparison. No new mathematical result is claimed.
Specific adaptive video-impersonation examples are concentrated in Episode 75. They were not equated with prompt injection or agent tool misuse.
These open questions need deeper interpretive review. Work productivity, human worth and machine motivation are not treated as interchangeable.
